name: I Got Transported Into My How To Draw Manga Book!?
source:
Mica (name changeable) is an art student wondering burnt out on making art. Stressed from incoming final projects they never were able to start, they fall asleep on a copy of a How to Draw Manga book they had when they were a teenager. Suddenly, they get transported into the How to Draw Manga book and meet the characters in the book, Pigma and Sakura. 

With Pigma and Sakura’s help, will Mica be able to draw to get themself home when their creative self-esteem is at its lowest?

A visual novel about learning to draw again. 

[From [url=https://knickknackpj.itch.io/howtodrawmangaisekai]itch.io[/url]]
